ops.text: Sprite drive relay: 'drive job report j5305' (started 04:43) never returned; its answer arrived about 80 minutes later as an orca status message 'Re: Question' (msg_032fd6d2dfaa) that 'orca orchestration check' consumed, while the waiting 'drive' process (orca ask --resume loop in ~/.local/bin/drive) kept waiting. Later verbs (drive pr add at 05:26, drive job set at 05:47) are still unanswered past 75 minutes. Either the coordinator answers a relayed DRIVE question as a new message instead of the ask's reply, or the relay's resume loop misses it.
